paragraphs: The Zhang Research Group at Institute of Biopharmaceutical and Health Engineering (iBHE) at Tsinghua University is focused on the live-cell pharmaceutical engineering, with a major emphasis on the design and preparation of functional biomaterials and drug delivery technology for complementary interactions to generate a "smart" system, interesting in neutrophil engneering, surface engineering of bacteria, and AI for formulation.

announcements.title: Welcome New Graduate Students to the Zhang Lab
announcements.description: We warmly welcome Qiqi GE, Huai Yi WONG, Pimnipa Chaijaraswong, Cathleen Rebecca, Mengyu Yang, and Lin Shiming, who join us as Master's students this Fall. Welcome aboard!

announcements.title: Welcome Kun YANG and Xiaotong ZHAO to the Zhang Lab
announcements.description: We warmly welcome Kun YANG and Xiaotong ZHAO, who join us as PhD students this Fall. Kun will work on novel oral drug delivery systems, while Xiaotong continues her research on microneedle-based drug delivery. Welcome aboard!
